headline: Hiểu Vy climbs from 59th to 46th on ARC-2

sections.text: Hiểu Vy gained 9.16 to 53.33, moving from 59th to 46th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board in the past day.
The entry is listed under its own name. Standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
